player_prompt.intro:
You are solving the Sokoban puzzle. You are the player and you need to push all boxes to targets.
        When you are right next to a box, you can push it by moving in the same direction.
        You cannot push a box through a wall, and you cannot pull a box.
        On the board, objects are represented as: 
        - The player (you) appears as 'P' 
        - Walls are represented with '#' 
        - Boxes are marked as 'X' 
        - Empty goals are shown with a 'O'
        - Boxes on goals are visualized with '√'
        You can also use [w] for up, [a] for left, [s] for down, and [d] for right.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nusi kɔkɔ ɖi ɖɔ wɔnɔ na ɖɛɖi si. Na yi [up], [down], [left], [right] kple [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: Nǔ e è sɔ́ dó así nú mi ɔ́ nyí nǔ ɖagbe ɖé ǎ.
invalid_move.wall_collision: A sixu yì dǒ mɛ ǎ!
invalid_move.invalid_position: Dàn nú nùɖé - è sixu yì tɛn enɛ mɛ ǎ.

game_message.pushed_prefix: é dó xasun ɖokpo mɛ ɖò hwenu e è nɔ ɖè ɔ

outcome.win: Un dó kú nú mi! Mi ɖe Sokoban sín nùkanbyɔ ɔ do.
outcome.turn_limit: A mɔ nǔ e è ɖó na dó lɛ́ɛ bǐ. É ɖɔ xó nú we ǎ.
